verdict.rationale: Headless or CI automation is a fair question for an authenticator or credential tool, since some products of this kind ship CLIs or programmatic code generation. The evidence describes only an interactive mobile app: biometric or PIN approvals, App Lock prompts, and QR-code setup. The probes found no API surface (OpenAPI, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404), so nothing shows headless, CLI or CI use.
